💛 When both mothers and fathers are involved in parenting their children everyone benefits!

rows.text_1_facilitator: 4️⃣ Here are four simple ways you can become a more confident and supportive spouse AND parent.

text_1_facilitator.eng: 4️⃣ Here are four simple ways you can become a more confident and supportive spouse AND parent.

section_1_text.eng: ⚽ Show your spouse that you appreciate it when they spend quality time with your children.

section_2_text.eng:
😃 If you are unsure on how to work together with your spouse, ask them! 
✅ By asking, you show that you care and want to be involved!

section_3_text.eng:
👋 You may sometimes forget to ask your spouse if they need help. 
💡 When you start asking, they’ll see you want to be involved - and might begin asking for your help too.

section_4_text.eng:
😒 Asking for help can be hard. Sometimes we expect our spouses to just know we need it. 
⭐ Once you start asking, they’re more likely to start offering help in the future! 
💚 Remember to thank your spouse!

rows.quiz_1_question: Home activity! ⭐ Try doing childcare or housework together with your spouse. Do you have time to do it today?

quiz_1_question.eng: Home activity! ⭐ Try doing childcare or housework together with your spouse. Do you have time to do it today?

quiz_1_feedback_3.eng:
Sometimes it can be hard to find time during the day. Can you think of a time when you’re less busy? 🌷

For example, maybe it is easier to do housework together later in the evening when some of the children have gone to sleep. Try to see what works for you! ⭐
